import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;
import java.math.BigInteger;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 998244353;
    static long[] pow10 = new long[17];
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        
        long n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine().trim());
        
        String nStr = Long.toString(n);
        int nLen = nStr.length();
        
        pow10[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < 17; i++) {
            pow10[i] = pow10[i-1] * 10;
        }
        
        BigInteger ans = BigInteger.ZERO;
        
        for (int len = 1; len <= nLen; len++) {
            long cur = 0;
            StringBuilder curSt = new StringBuilder();
            
            for (int firstDiff = 0; firstDiff < nLen && firstDiff < len; firstDiff++) {
                if (firstDiff > 0) {
                    cur = cur * 10 + (nStr.charAt(firstDiff-1) - '0');
                    curSt.append(nStr.charAt(firstDiff-1));
                }
                
                for (int lastDig = 0; lastDig <= 9; lastDig++) {
                    if (firstDiff == 0 && lastDig == 0) continue;
                    if (lastDig == nStr.charAt(firstDiff) - '0') continue;
                    if (len == nLen && lastDig > nStr.charAt(firstDiff) - '0') continue;
                    
                    long curP = cur * 10 + lastDig;
                    StringBuilder curStP = new StringBuilder(curSt).append((char)('0' + lastDig));
                    
                    long base = 0;
                    StringBuilder tmp = new StringBuilder();
                    
                    for (int pos = 0; pos < curStP.length(); pos++) {
                        char start = (pos == 0 ? '1' : '0');
                        for (char dig = start; dig < curStP.charAt(pos); dig++) {
                            base += countWithPrefix(tmp.toString() + dig, n, nStr);
                        }
                        tmp.append(curStP.charAt(pos));
                    }
                    base += len - 1;
                    
                    List<Integer> variables = new ArrayList<>();
                    for (int pos = curStP.length(); pos < len; pos++) {
                        variables.add((int)(countWithPrefix(tmp.toString() + '0', n, nStr) % MOD));
                        tmp.append('0');
                    }
                    
                    base += 1;
                    base -= curP * pow10[len - curStP.length()];
                    for (int t = 0; t < variables.size(); t++) {
                        variables.set(variables.size() - 1 - t, (int)((variables.get(variables.size() - 1 - t) - pow10[t]) % MOD));
                    }
                    
                    base %= MOD;
                    if (base < 0) base += MOD;
                    
                    for (int i = 0; i < variables.size(); i++) {
                        int val = variables.get(i) % MOD;
                        if (val < 0) val += MOD;
                        variables.set(i, val);
                    }
                    
                    BigInteger result = solve(variables, (int)base);
                    ans = ans.add(result);
                }
            }
        }
        
        long cur = 0;
        StringBuilder curSt = new StringBuilder();
        
        for (int len = 1; len <= nLen; len++) {
            curSt.append(nStr.charAt(len-1));
            cur = cur * 10 + (nStr.charAt(len-1) - '0');
            
            long val = 1;
            StringBuilder tmp = new StringBuilder();
            for (int pos = 0; pos < curSt.length(); pos++) {
                char start = (pos == 0 ? '1' : '0');
                for (char dig = start; dig < curSt.charAt(pos); dig++) {
                    val += countWithPrefix(tmp.toString() + dig, n, nStr);
                }
                tmp.append(curSt.charAt(pos));
            }
            val += len - 1;
            val -= cur;
            val %= MOD;
            if (val < 0) val += MOD;
            
            ans = ans.add(BigInteger.valueOf(val));
        }
        
        ans = ans.mod(BigInteger.valueOf(1000000007));
        pw.println(ans.toString());
        pw.flush();
    }
    
    static BigInteger solve(List<Integer> variables, int base) {
        BigInteger answer = BigInteger.ZERO;
        int n = variables.size();
        int mid = n / 2;
        
        List<Integer> rem1 = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> rem2;
        
        int[] cur = new int[1];
        int[] until = new int[1];
        
        cur[0] = base;
        until[0] = mid;
        bruteForce(variables, cur, until, 0, rem1);
        
        rem2 = new ArrayList<>(rem1);
        rem1.clear();
        cur[0] = 0;
        until[0] = n;
        bruteForce(variables, cur, until, mid, rem1);
        
        Collections.sort(rem1);
        Collections.sort(rem2);
        
        long totalRSum = 0;
        for (int x : rem2) {
            totalRSum += x;
        }
        
        int j = rem2.size() - 1;
        for (int a : rem1) {
            while (j >= 0 && (long)a + rem2.get(j) >= MOD) {
                j--;
            }
            answer = answer.add(BigInteger.valueOf((long)a * rem2.size() + totalRSum - (long)(rem2.size() - 1 - j) * MOD));
        }
        
        return answer;
    }
    
    static void bruteForce(List<Integer> variables, int[] cur, int[] until, int start, List<Integer> results) {
        if (start == until[0]) {
            results.add(cur[0]);
            return;
        }
        int oldCur = cur[0];
        for (int t = 0; t < 10; t++) {
            bruteForce(variables, cur, until, start + 1, results);
            cur[0] = (cur[0] + variables.get(start)) % MOD;
        }
        cur[0] = oldCur;
    }
    
    static long countWithPrefix(String s, long n, String nStr) {
        long ans = 0;
        long sVal = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
            sVal = sVal * 10 + (s.charAt(i) - '0');
        }
        
        for (int len = s.length(); len <= nStr.length(); len++) {
            if (len < nStr.length()) {
                ans += pow10[len - s.length()];
            } else {
                int cmp = s.compareTo(nStr.substring(0, s.length()));
                if (cmp < 0) {
                    ans += pow10[len - s.length()];
                } else if (cmp == 0) {
                    ans += (n + 1) - sVal * pow10[nStr.length() - s.length()];
                }
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }
}
